contentText:
This is partner content.

In this episode of Rock the Look , presented by Neutrogena, celebrity makeup artist Micaela Cleary breaks down how to create the ultimate effortless pop girl glam. From glowing skin prep to soft, camera-ready makeup, Micaela reveals why skin care is the foundation behind every standout beauty look. Plus, she shares pro tips, must-have products and easy techniques to achieve a fresh, radiant finish worthy of any pop star moment.

Micaela Cleary: Helping artists show up as their most beautiful self is so special. As a celebrity makeup artist, I love the ability to be creative. Makeup is art, and the most important step is always skin prep. My name is Micaela Cleary, and this is Rock the Look, pop girl edition, presented by Neutrogena. Hi, I’m Micaela.

Neena Roe: Hi, I’m Neena, it’s so nice to meet you.

So nice to meet you. Are you ready to get started?

Yes, I’m so excited. 

Do you have anything on your skin right now?

No, I actually just cleansed.

OK, perfect, did you just use makeup wipes?

I did. 

You used the fragrance-free ones from Neutrogena?

Yes, they’re great. The great thing I feel about it is that I don’t actually feel dry. I did all this cleansing, and my skin still feels moisturized.

Did you use the Hydroboost cleanser? 

Yes, I did! It was so nice and not drying at all. I really loved it. I could use it again and again.

Yeah, that’s my favorite one. It has hyaluronic acid in it, which I don’t know if you know, but it holds up to a thousand times its weight in water, so it’s a really great connectant. Your skin is already looking amazing, so let’s go in with some serum and give it some more hydration so your skin will last all day.

OK, amazing, let’s do it.

Keep watching for more!
